scope: Static ZIP listing, text reads and independent SHA256 only; no archive script, EXE, DLL, installer, bundled Python or game was executed; no user account configuration or save contents read.

findings.title: Standard save path is hard-coded
findings.interpretation: Only USERPROFILE/LocalLow/91Act/BlazblueEntropyEffect Steam and XBoxPc save slots are enumerated; a different runtime save root must be explicitly located and independently backed up before mutation. This static result does not identify the actual active save.

findings.title: Reported encode roundtrip is not implemented
findings.interpretation: verify_table only counts length-prefixed records and prints; there is no semantic decode comparison or final boundary assertion.

findings.title: Setup completeness is not a process exit gate
findings.interpretation: Bundle parse errors are skipped; unresolved JS and failed table decodes are counted but do not force a nonzero exit. Setup trusts return code and writes build marker.

findings.title: Install consists of separate commits
findings.interpretation: m_mod.m and merge.json are individually replaced, manifest is written afterward without an atomic temp replace, installed.json last. Need interrupted update and restore tests; this is a static failure window, not a reproduced crash.

findings.title: Missing type tree fallback material
findings.interpretation: No dump/DummyDll or tools/typetrees exists in this release. It may work for bundles with suitable embedded type trees; otherwise fallback raises SystemExit. Actual baseline bundle coverage requires validation.

findings.title: Table ownership and key uniqueness need broader regression tests
findings.interpretation: Base index silently keeps last duplicate key; new/copy/replace set wildcard owner but ordinary field writes inspect only field owner; append does not update index. Existing four tests do not establish complete conflict detection.

findings.title: Build reproduction needs pinned fallback dependencies and test fixture
findings.interpretation: Bundled runtime is present; fallback pip installs latest missing packages without pinned versions. Composer JSON has results and a source hash but no included runnable test/fixtures or mapping for that extracted-source hash.

findings.title: Decoded pristine snapshots persist across re-setup
findings.interpretation: pipeline overwrites live decoded tables and JS but does not refresh/remove their .orig files; ensure_orig preserves first snapshot and composers reload it. Re-setup can stamp a new build while subsequent composition still uses prior-build snapshots. Requires version-scoped snapshot refresh and hash validation; not dynamically reproduced.

97: A Steam update puts the game's own files back, which switches mods off. **The normal game can't load a save that still names a mod character.** It reports the save as corrupted. Your progress is still there.
99: This release works with game build **25627491**. After the game updates, before you play:
101: 1. If the game says the save is corrupted, close the game. Don't choose anything that resets, deletes or overwrites the save.

103:    - **Keep playing your mods:** get the Terminal's release for the new build. This one stops at **SET UP AND INSTALL** with "no schema snapshot for game build ...", because the game is newer than it.
104:    - **Play without mods for now:** **Options > Saves and reports > REPAIR**. It copies your save, then takes the mod characters out of it so the normal game loads it.
106: If Steam updates games automatically, the update can arrive the moment you close the game.

111: - An install uses about 2 GB of memory while it builds. Close heavy programs first if your PC is short.
